meta_description: Organize movies, series, documentaries, and music across platforms — free
hero_sub1: Save what you want to watch and listen to from every platform in one place
hero_sub2: With AI recommendations tailored to your taste
cta_subtitle: Free signup, no credit card required
terms_purpose_text: This app is built for movie lovers — great films are scattered across platforms. We only provide a playlist so you can save items and set "don't forget to watch" reminders.
terms_not_owner_text: We don't provide streaming or store any movie/series/music files. All content lives on the original platforms (Netflix, Disney+, HBO, Prime, YouTube, Spotify, WeTV, VIU, iQIYI, Youku, etc.). You need your own subscription/account on those platforms.
terms_data_text: (titles, ratings, types) come from TMDb (free). We don't own this data.
terms_account_text: Uses Google login only to save your own items. We don't share data with third parties and don't collect unnecessary data.
terms_ai_text: Recommends additional titles based only on what you've already saved. No personal data used commercially.
terms_free_text: No fees, no ads, no charges.
